title: Teri Payal Mere Geet
desc: Premi makes a living by selling poems to Benni and falls in love with a courtesan, Laila Jaan. However, he leaves her after finding the truth about her but tries to get back with her.

title: Suhana Safar
desc: Enticed by his poetry, Sapna travels to India from the USA to meet poet Ujjwala. She meets a man, Sunil, who falls for her but decides to help her reach him in Phulwari.

title: Aa Gale Lag Jaa
desc: Roshni, a rich girl, is adamant on marrying Suraj, who is poor, until her mother reveals that his father is a former convict. Later, people around them are brutally killed by a seemingly unstoppable assailant.
